findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_approval_matrix, check_vendor_master, create_nda, create_rfq, audit_list, check_switchover, analyse_issues, review_contract, write_meeting_minutes · Private data: screen_sanctions, check_discount_window, check_approval_matrix, build_category_profile, find_in_list, analyse_spend, match_documents, check_vendor_master, list_templates, get_template, fill_template, find_comic, create_nda, open_table, score_offers, screen_supplier_risk, create_rfq, map_stakeholders, audit_list, esg_questionnaire, build_handover_file, write_invoice_letter, create_einvoice, reconcile_supplier_statement, check_approval_backlog · Public sink: build_category_profile, analyse_spend, check_vendor_master, create_nda, open_table, score_offers, screen_supplier_risk, segment_suppliers, create_rfq, check_kpis, check_portfolio, plan_sourcing, audit_list, check_switchover, analyse_issues, write_invoice_letter, plan_request_to_offer, check_blanket_orders, compare_offers, write_meeting_minutes · Destructive: check_discount_window, check_vendor_master, list_templates, open_table, change_table, delete_table, write_invoice_letter, create_einvoice, check_blanket_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_approval_matrix, check_vendor_master, create_nda, create_rfq, audit_list, check_switchover, analyse_issues, review_contract, write_meeting_minutes · Private data: screen_sanctions, check_discount_window, check_approval_matrix, build_category_profile, find_in_list, analyse_spend, match_documents, check_vendor_master, list_templates, get_template, fill_template, find_comic, create_nda, open_table, score_offers, screen_supplier_risk, create_rfq, map_stakeholders, audit_list, esg_questionnaire, build_handover_file, write_invoice_letter, create_einvoice, reconcile_supplier_statement, check_approval_backlog · Public sink: build_category_profile, analyse_spend, check_vendor_master, create_nda, open_table, score_offers, screen_supplier_risk, segment_suppliers, create_rfq, check_kpis, check_portfolio, plan_sourcing, audit_list, check_switchover, analyse_issues, write_invoice_letter, plan_request_to_offer, check_blanket_orders, compare_offers, write_meeting_minutes · Destructive: check_discount_window, check_vendor_master, list_templates, open_table, change_table, delete_table, write_invoice_letter, create_einvoice, check_blanket_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_price_increase" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "AICTIONBOT™ price increase check by KULIC Advisory. Compares a supplier's requested price increase with the official Eurostat producer price index (goods) or services producer price index plus labour cost index (services) for Germany since the last price agreement. Returns market change, gap in perc" → after: "AICTIONBOT™ price increase check by KULIC Advisory. Compares a supplier's requested price increase with the official Eurostat producer price index (goods) or services producer price index plus labour cost index (services) for Germany since the last price agreement. Returns market change, gap in perc"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
